steps_h2: How to Create AI Videos in 3 Simple Steps
steps_lead: Go from a product link or a photo to a clip you can post.

faq.q: How do I create an AI video?
faq.a: Upload a photo or paste a product link. Tell the video agent who the clip is for. Then download the file. You get a script, an AI actor, a voice, and on-screen captions. You see the credit cost before it starts.

faq.q: How do I describe the video?
faq.a: Say what the product is, who it is for, and what should happen on screen. The video agent can turn that note into a full script. A clear, well-lit photo of the whole item still helps.

faq.q: Can I make a news-style video?
faq.a: Yes. You can pick a news-style tone, a voice, a setting, a video shape, a language, and a length. The tool then writes the script. You can also make a promo, a how-to, or a product story. Lengths are 6, 10, 15, or 30 seconds.

faq.q: How does the generator build the clip?
faq.a: You enter the idea and choose the tone, the style, and where the clip will run. AIVideosUGC writes the script, makes the pictures, and hands back a clip you can edit.

faq.q: What is this generator built for?
faq.a: It is for store ads and product pages. You start from a photo or a product link. You pick an AI actor and a voice. Then you can send the clip to TikTok or Meta. It only makes clips about the product you sell.

faq.q: What kind of voices can I use?
faq.a: AI voices with lip sync, so the actor's mouth matches the words. Pick a brighter or a deeper voice, and switch languages for buyers in other countries.

faq.q: Do I need to install software?
faq.a: No. You work in the browser. The editor, captions, and music library all work in the browser too. Download when you want a file. It has no watermark.

faq.q: Can I generate a video from a photo I already have?
faq.a: Yes. Upload one clear photo you have the right to use. The product in the clip comes from that picture. You can also paste a product link instead.

Starter is $24.50 a month for 200 credits. Pro is $35 for 300 credits. Premium is $63 for 600 credits. A 6-second clip uses 24 credits. A 10-second clip uses 40. A 15-second clip uses 60. A 30-second clip uses 120. If a clip fails, the credits come back.

faq.q: Do these clips work for ads?
faq.a: You can run them as ads you pay for, or as organic posts. Results depend on the product and the audience. Use them to test the opening. Keep a filmed ad when you want a real customer on camera.

faq.q: Can I start from a product page link?
faq.a: Yes. Paste the product link and the tool drafts the script, the AI actor, and the voice. The same steps are on the [product link to video](page:url-to-video) page if you want them on their own.

faq.q: Can I make several versions to test?
faq.a: Yes. Keep the photo and change the opening, the AI actor, the voice, or the video shape. Each version is one clip, and the credit cost shows before it starts.

faq.q: Can I run the clip on TikTok or Meta?
faq.a: Yes. Send the clip to TikTok or Meta, or download it and post it yourself. Shapes are tall (9:16), square (1:1), wide (16:9), 4:3, and 3:4. Do not post an AI actor as a customer review. Add any label the platform asks for.

faq.q: What is included for an ecommerce ad?
faq.a: You start with a product photo or a link. You get an AI actor from the actor library, an AI voice, on-screen captions, and more than one language. You can send the clip to TikTok or Meta. Plans start at $24.50 a month. You can use the file in ads, and it has no watermark.

faq.q: Which kind of video tool should I open?
faq.a: Open the tool that fits the clip: a still photo turned into motion, a spoken ad, a product demo, an unboxing, or an AI actor.

faq.q: How long does a video take?
faq.a: There is no fixed wait. It depends on the length and how many other tasks are ahead of yours. On-screen captions, the voice, and a song from the music library are part of the clip. You can still change them in the editor.
